generation_history.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural heritage plate for 访古.
Image 1 is a STYLE MASTER only, the Vairocana contour drawing: borrow elegant delicate slightly organic thin black contours and sparse internal detail, never its figure geometry. Image 2 is the actual Datong Nine Dragon Wall (大同九龙壁), and determines the subject geometry. Draw only this entire long Ming glazed-ceramic screen wall, from its left end to its right end, seen straight-on, centered with verticals vertical. Preserve its extremely wide low 45.5m by 8m overall proportions, continuous low hip-roof cap, ridge ornaments, horizontal frieze, the nine large dragon relief compositions across the face, and tiered rectangular base. EXACTLY NINE dragon figures across the wall, one central dragon with four on either side, positions and broad coiled silhouettes matching the photograph. Do not make nine separate standing statues or divide the wall into nine framed rectangular panels. Relief contours are simplified, clouds and waves selectively indicated. Remove obstructing willow branches, fence, lawn, water basin, people and modern background; do not invent dragons or decorative architecture.
Render crisp fine BLACK INK lines on a perfectly flat OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas. Every blank surface inside and outside the wall is white, ALL pixels fully opaque, absolutely NO transparent output or alpha removal. No shaded wall fill, crosshatching, grey wash, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, shadow or checkerboard. Sparse roof strokes and relief outlines, generous white surfaces, no labels, letters, calligraphy, captions, watermark, frame or border. We remove the WHITE by script ourselves later.
Landscape 1536x1024, complete wall occupies about 86% of width. Preserve the real very wide proportions with lots of white space above and below, do not stretch it vertically to fill the canvas. Roof corners and base uncut, at least 7% side margin. Only a few thin ground lines.
